why: Floors whose placed things the world does not remember. A thing placed on one of these maps stands for the visit; it is not written to user://inventory/placed.json, and a row already kept there is not stood again by the next game. Palle, 2026-11-23, on the Prefab Test floor: 'when we add an object the objects stay ... for now the world should not remember these'. Read by commons/player/inventory_hand.gd (_forgotten).
